iso24512_kpis.description: ISO 24512:2007 Water service management KPIs with benchmark thresholds
iso24512_kpis.standard: ISO 24512:2007 — Activities relating to drinking water and wastewater services

kpis.name: Water losses (Non-Revenue Water)
kpis.description: % of water produced that does not generate revenue (leaks, unbilled use)
kpis.how: Flag events with z-score > 2.5 and duration > 60 min as suspected leaks; sum their volume as % of total

kpis.name: Service continuity
kpis.description: Hours per year with uninterrupted water supply
kpis.requires: Pressure sensor data or supply schedule

kpis.name: Water quality compliance
kpis.description: % of samples meeting drinking water quality standards

kpis.name: Specific daily consumption
kpis.description: Average litres consumed per person per day

kpis.name: Peak day factor
kpis.description: Ratio of max daily consumption to average daily consumption

kpis.name: Anomaly response time
kpis.description: Time between anomaly detection and corrective action
kpis.how: detect_anomalies provides timestamp; WaterSec alert fires immediately on detection

kpis.name: Metering rate
kpis.how: gym=100% (8 sensors/8 outlets), customerC=100% (7 sensors), customerA=partial, customerB=low (1 sensor/9+ fixtures)

kpis.name: Average flow rate efficiency
kpis.description: Mean flow rate vs. fixture design spec (shower: 8 L/min, tap: 6 L/min, flush: 6 L/flush)
kpis.how: query_data returns flow_rate_Lpm — compare to benchmarks above per sub_category

site_occupancy_estimates.description: Estimated occupancy for W4 KPI calculation
